infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Betty uses your location for your speed, the weather and the places on your ride.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Betty listens when you talk to her: while you hold the talk button, or all ride with Open mic on.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Betty keeps your speed, route and alerts going while the phone is locked or another app is in front, during a ride only.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Betty reads your bike's engine data (temperature, revs, battery, fault codes) from your OBD2 reader over Bluetooth.
